title: Local LLM Benchmark Run
description: One benchmark run of a local LLM. Units are encoded in field names: _tok_s = tokens/second, _s = seconds, _gb = gigabytes, *context_length*/*_tokens* = token counts. Stable filter keys for the API/UI: model.name, runtime.name, quantization, hardware.gpu.

id.description: Unique run id. Optional: the storage API assigns one when absent.

timestamp.description: UTC time the run started, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-01T14:30:00+00:00).

version.description: Runtime version if known, else null.

quantization.description: Weight quantization of the model file, e.g. 'Q4_K_M', 'Q8_0', 'FP16', 'NVFP4'. Free string: naming varies per runtime.

gpu.description: GPU model used, e.g. 'NVIDIA RTX 4090'; 'CPU' when no GPU.

gpu_vram_total_gb.description: Total GPU memory in gigabytes, null if unknown.

metrics.description: Measured metrics. Values are explicit null when not measurable (failed run, missing counter).

ttft_s.description: Time to first token in seconds.

vram_peak_gb.description: Peak GPU memory used, in gigabytes.

status.description: success: all metrics present. partial: run finished, some metrics null. error: run failed, most metrics null.

raw_output.description: Raw runtime log/output captured for the run. May be empty.

command.description: Exact command (or equivalent invocation) used for this run, so the result can be reproduced. null when not captured.

name.description: The agentic task the model was solving, e.g. 'resolve a failing pytest run'.

time_to_solution_s.description: Wall-clock seconds from task start to solution. null when the task was not solved or timing unknown.

success.description: true when the task was solved within the run.

agent_task.description: Present only for agentic-task runs: time-to-solution and success/failure. Absent for plain throughput runs.

example.description: true when this run is synthetic sample data, not a measured benchmark. Absent or false = real run.
